sample_unit: lesion-level entries from prostate MRI reports (1,118 patients)

links.outcome: Reproducibility, temporal stability, and invalid outputs across model versions
links.effect: GPT-5.2 outperformed ChatGPT-4o in paired analyses but produced invalid outputs in a minority of cases; intra-model reproducibility and temporal stability were also evaluated.
links.quote: GPT-5.2 outperformed ChatGPT-4o in paired analyses but produced invalid outputs in a minority of cases.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs for text-only inference of PI-RADS categories from radiology reports as a supervised quality-control tool

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM performance on inferring PI-RADS scores from text reports compared to human radiologists, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
